name: bar-chart
title: Bar Chart
description: A column chart for bucketed counts: every column labelled, one optionally featured, a tooltip and highlight on hover. Uses namespace exports: BarChart.Root.

docs.lead: One rounded column per bucket, grey until hovered, with every bucket labelled underneath. Built from flex rather than a charting library so no label is ever dropped. Heights use an 8px baseline plus the value’s share of the remaining height: zero stays at 8px and the maximum fills the chart. Extremely small positives may add less than a visible pixel. Tooltips show actual values.
docs.usage:
import * as BarChart from "@/components/ui/bar-chart"

<BarChart.Root
  items={[{ label: "0 - 9", value: 111 }]}
  dimension="Group"
  unit="Items"
/>

examples.title: Default
examples.description: Every column is grey until hovered, when its column and label take the featured colours and its tooltip shows the actual count. dimension and unit name what the tooltip shows.

examples.title: Minimum height
examples.description: Zero stays at 8px; positive counts rise proportionally above that baseline. Tiny positives can still look like zero when the extra height is less than a visible pixel. Tooltips keep actual values.
examples.code: <BarChart.Root items={[{ label: "Zero", value: 0 }, { label: "Small", value: 1 }, { label: "Large", value: 1000 }]} unit="Items" />

api.name: BarChart.Root
api.description: The columns and their label row. Fills its container's height.

props.name: items
props.description: Columns left to right, in the order given

props.name: highlighted
props.description: Label of the column to feature. Omitted or null features none

props.name: dimension
props.description: What the buckets are, after the bucket in the tooltip caption ("10 - 19 Group"). For ranges; leave it off where the bucket names itself

props.name: unit
props.description: What the value counts, beside it in the tooltip
